label: Tool calls break after the first call
hint: A failed fix becomes a deeper task
title: Tool loop 400: tool message without preceding assistant tool_calls
description: The tool-calling loop drops the assistant message before tool results and returns None when the model spends its budget reasoning. A naive first patch usually fixes only the ordering; the verifier fails it and the failure becomes a deeper child task.

ticket.title: Agent tool loop fails with 400 after the first tool call
ticket.description: Our support agent calls one tool and then the next chat completion request fails with HTTP 400. This started when we moved the agent to Nemotron on Crusoe Managed Inference.
ticket.expected_behavior: The tool-calling loop completes tool calls against Nemotron models on Crusoe and returns the model's final answer text.
